blurb: Multiple options selected as removable tags, searchable dropdown.
description: Displays selected items as tags with optional icons, opens a searchable popover to add/remove selections. Supports a "select all" option.
use_when: Choosing multiple items from a list where users need to see and manage all selections.
avoid_when: Single-select scenarios, or when screen space is constrained.
a11y: Keyboard navigable with Enter/Space to toggle, Escape to close popover. Focus management within the command list.
